findings.summary: Malformed ledger records are not fail-closed
findings.detail: Ledger parsing validates only that events is an array. Individual records and schema_version are not validated.

findings.summary: Quarantine recovery fails when prior index generations exist
findings.detail: Generation changes can keep referencing a quarantined month and block the next request with an index inconsistency.

findings.summary: Initialized cache can mask later ledger corruption
findings.detail: A ledger corrupted without a generation change can be served from cache instead of failing closed.

findings.summary: Malformed API responses are reported as empty weeks
findings.detail: Missing or non-array events are converted to an empty week instead of failing without posting.

summary: Authentication and lock boundaries are sound, but ledger validation, quarantine recovery, cache authority, and malformed KPI API response handling require changes.
